title: Bosses: tiers, damage cap and Black Clover
text: Every boss of the mod can lose at most 6% of its health per second (min. 20 health per second, 1.5 times that in the final phase; nusmp-boss-budget-server.toml), so the fastest fight lasts about 17 seconds on a plain boss. Bosses never regenerate and never use Unique or Ultimate skills (nusmp-boss-rules-server.toml). Black Clover bosses (the Dark Triad, Lucius Zogratis, the Devil Avatar, Zagred, the Midnight Sun elves, the Spade bosses) have three times health and deal three times damage (bossRules.blackCloverStatMultiplier 3.0, 1 = off); a boosted hit still never takes more than half of your health. Bosses of the Zogratis framework scale with the party size at the start of the fight. Boss tiers 1 to 4 add barriers and an anti-magic aura: Goliath and Charybdis Spawn tier 1; Dante, Vanica and Zenon tier 2; the Devil Avatar tier 3; Lucius tier 4. Deep in the Mega-Dungeon, every tenth floor has a Decennial boss; from floor 250 on it drops 2 to 5 boss cores (more the deeper you go) that craft four armour families (Aegis, Striker, Wellspring, Ascendant). Each of the 23 grimoire bosses also drops a trophy and silver coins, and gold coins on your first kill of it.
